assets.name: hero
assets.prompt: Create an original wide illustration for a Japanese house-cleaning landing page. STYLE IS CRITICAL: simple Japanese explanatory manga like the reference: bold clean dark outlines, rounded expressive adult faces, flat colors with only modest cel shading, drawn backgrounds. Absolutely no photorealism, realistic anime rendering, 3D, glossy skin or photographic textures. The reference is ONLY a style guide, do not copy its characters, content or layout. Original friendly woman in her 30s with short chestnut bob hair, cream cardigan and pale blue shirt talks to a polite professional male cleaner in his 30s with short black hair, navy polo, light grey work trousers and no logos. They stand in a tidy bright living room, looking at each other while the cleaner explains a simple checklist on a clipboard. Visible full upper bodies and enough room context: couch, window, wall mounted air conditioner, protected floor and neatly arranged cleaning bag. Eye level, welcoming calm scene, medium wide composition, landscape 3:2, blue/navy/white palette with warm natural accents. No text, no speech bubbles, no branding, no decorative badges. This should look like a hand-drawn commercial explainer manga illustration, with unmistakably simplified facial features and strong outlines.

usage: Original character identity reference and text-free Open Graph preview only. Current finished LP artwork is recorded in art-assets.json.
